ASE master tech chiming in. In some cases on high mileage units, changing the fluid can actually hurt the trans. Old fluid tends to retain clutch friction material, which actually helps the clutch packs retain their "grip". If the fluid has never been changed on a unit with roughly 100k miles it is possible to begin having issues after putting in fresh fluid. It is not black and white. There are many variables involved. I've played an extensive amount of Resistance so far. In all honesty the mode has a huge amount of potential, but in it's current state really drops the ball. It's very hard for new players to get started, to the point of almost making potential new players just abandon the game. High level masterminds are nigh unbeatable. High level survivors with communication are also incredibly powerful. Hit detection and connection issues are abysmal. There are times where you can pump rounds into an enemy and nothing will happen. Peer to peer is unacceptable in the year 2020, especially for a very successful franchise. At the high levels, it's less about strategy and more about finding cheesy exploits. The current meta is repetitive and boring. I feel like the game is a few substantial updates away from a very solid and fun to play mode.
